content: Letter 12, to Vazīr Ghiyās al-Dīn Ḥāfiẓ Rāzī (ca. 816/1413, Isfahan?), Iskandar's chief vizier: he appreciates the vizier's regard for religious leaders and scholars, uses an epithet MK reads as showing esoteric interests, and recommends the young learned Mawlānā Sharaf al-Dīn Yaʿqūb to his service as qadi (presumably in Isfahan), since Ibn Turka is moving his family to Shiraz; he asks the vizier's help (TMN/MS pp. 7-8). Per MK's footnote, Ḥāfiẓ Rāzī (d. 825/1422), based in Yazd, was later charged by Shāhrukh with transporting the Yazd-made kiswa to the Hijaz.
